expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
Planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping-only message by introducing request identifiers for correlating requests and responses, timestamps for message creation time, and optional payload data while preserving clear encoding and decoding behavior.

Shipped v2 Hello support with the explicit `v:2|hello|<message>` envelope while preserving existing Ping behavior.
